content.text: God walking in the garden, Gen. 3:8 (Moses 4:14). Enoch walked with God, Gen. 5:24 (Moses 7:69). Noah walked with God, Gen. 6:9 (Moses 8:27). Abram … walk before me, Gen. 17:1. Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel, Gen. 24:40. God, before whom … Abraham and Isaac did walk, Gen. 48:15. prove them, whether they will walk in my law, Ex. 16:4. shew them the way wherein they must walk, Ex. 18:20. keep mine ordinances, to walk therein, Lev. 18:4 (Ezek. 11:20; D&C 136:4). If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, Lev. 26:3 (Ezek. 11:20; 20:19; 37:24). I will walk among you, and will be your God, Lev. 26:12 (2 Cor. 6:16). walk in all the ways which the Lord … commanded, Deut. 5:33 (Josh. 22:5; Jer. 7:23). keep the commandments of … God, to walk in his ways, Deut. 8:6. fear the Lord … to walk in all his ways, Deut. 10:12. love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, Deut. 11:22 (19:9; Mosiah 6:6; 23:14; 29:43; Alma 25:14; Ether 10:2). walk after the Lord your God, and fear him, Deut. 13:4 (Neh. 5:9; Ps. 128:1; Hosea 11:10). God walketh in the midst of thy camp, Deut. 23:14. keep the way of the Lord to walk therein, Judg. 2:22. thy house … should walk before me for ever, 1 Sam. 2:30. I have walked with all … Israel, 2 Sam. 7:7 (1 Chr. 17:6). charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, 1 Kgs. 2:3 (3:14; 9:4). thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart, 1 Kgs. 8:23 (2 Chr. 6:14). walk in my ways, and do that is right, 1 Kgs. 11:38. made a covenant … to walk after the Lord, 2 Kgs. 23:3 (2 Chr. 34:31). walk before me, as David thy father, 2 Chr. 7:17. walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, Ps. 15:2. though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, Ps. 23:4. that I may walk before God in the light of the living, Ps. 56:13. no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly, Ps. 84:11. I will walk in thy truth, Ps. 86:11. shall walk … in the light of thy countenance, Ps. 89:15. he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me, Ps. 101:6. I will walk before the Lord, Ps. 116:9. Blessed are the undefiled … who walk in the law of the Lord, Ps. 119:1. he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly, Prov. 2:7. He that walketh uprightly walketh surely, Prov. 10:9. He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord, Prov. 14:2. just man walketh in his integrity, Prov. 20:7. Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved, Prov. 28:18. come … walk in the light of the Lord, Isa. 2:5 (Micah 4:2; 2 Ne. 12:5). This is the way, walk ye in it, Isa. 30:21. He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly, Isa. 33:15. giveth … spirit to them that walk therein, Isa. 42:5. each one walking in his uprightness, Isa. 57:2. where is the good way, and walk therein, Jer. 6:16. walk in my law, which I have set before you, Jer. 26:4 (Dan. 9:10). ways of the Lord … the just shall walk in them, Hosea 14:9. Lord require … to walk humbly with thy God, Micah 6:8 (D&C 11:12). If thou wilt walk in my ways, Zech. 3:7.

walk in the steps of that faith of our father, Rom. 4:12. walk in newness of life, Rom. 6:4. who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit, Rom. 8:1. Let us walk honestly, Rom. 13:13. Lord hath called every one, so let him walk, 1 Cor. 7:17. we walk by faith, 2 Cor. 5:7. Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust, Gal. 5:16 (5:25). good works … ordained that we should walk in them, Eph. 2:10. walk worthy of the vocation, Eph. 4:1. walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, Eph. 5:2. walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, Col. 1:10 (1 Thes. 2:12). received Christ … so walk ye in him, Col. 2:6. Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, Col. 4:5. how ye ought to walk and to please God, 1 Thes. 4:1. walk in the light, as he is in the light, 1 Jn. 1:7. walk, even as he walked, 1 Jn. 2:6. this is love, that we walk after his commandments, 2 Jn. 1:6 (4 Ne. 1:12; D&C 88:133). no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth, 3 Jn. 1:4. they shall walk with me in white, Rev. 3:4. them which are saved shall walk in the light, Rev. 21:24.

walk uprightly before God, 1 Ne. 16:3 (Mosiah 18:29; Alma 1:1; 45:24; 53:21; 63:2; D&C 46:7; 68:28; 90:24). walk in the strait path which leads to life, 2 Ne. 33:9. served you, walking with a clear conscience before God, Mosiah 2:27. teach them to walk in the ways of truth, Mosiah 4:15. walk guiltless before God, Mosiah 4:26. man of God, walking in his ways, Mosiah 23:14. walking in all diligence, Mosiah 26:38. Have ye walked, keeping yourselves blameless, Alma 5:27. humble themselves and do walk after the holy order of God, Alma 5:54 (7:22). whosoever will may walk therein and be saved, Alma 41:8. Lamanites … walk in truth and uprightness, Hel. 6:34. walk circumspectly before God, Hel. 15:5. taught to walk humbly before the Lord, Ether 6:17 (6:30).

walk more uprightly before me, D&C 5:21 (18:31). walk in the meekness of my Spirit, D&C 19:23. walk in the paths of virtue before me, D&C 25:2. walk in all the commandments of God, D&C 88:133. walk uprightly and remember the covenant, D&C 90:24. work together for good to them that walk uprightly, D&C 100:15 (109:1). he saw the Lord, and he walked with him, D&C 107:49.
walked in holiness before the Lord, Moses 5:26 (D&C 20:69; 21:4). abide in me, and I in you; therefore walk with me, Moses 6:34. no man laid hands on him … for he walked with God, Moses 6:39.
